issue_request: FHIR-7361 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 FHIR-core lifecycle-page change request asking to change the clinical workflow lifecycle definition of cancelled from "the planned activity will not take place" to "the planned activity did not start and will not take place".
initial_application: The issue was applied in SVN revision 6455, mirrored as git commit ec3d90cb20247c1642d7756e1b96b30e40bd2d80, which changed source/lifecycle.html exactly to the requested clarified wording.
additional_context: source/lifecycle.html is in current build scope through publish.ini and source/hierarchy.xml. Later lifecycle-page reconciliations for FHIR-7363 and FHIR-32152 touched the same page but did not change the cancelled/stopped distinction, and Jira/Zulip/Confluence searches found no later conflicting evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current Clinical Workflow Process Life Cycle list already says "cancelled - the planned activity did not start and will not take place" and separately defines "stopped (aborted, failed)" as not completed with no future action planned.
